cases.name: restore view A brings back its sort and keeps view B filter

args.file:
filters:
  and:
    - 'file.hasProperty("status")'
formulas:
  total: '1 + 1'
views:
  - type: table
    name: A
    filters: 'file.name != x'
    order:
      - file.name
      - asc
  - type: table
    name: B
    filters: 'status = todo'
args.edit:
filters:
  and:
    - 'file.hasProperty("status")'
formulas:
  total: '1 + 1'
views:
  - type: table
    name: A
    filters: 'file.name != x'
    order:
      - file.name
      - desc
  - type: table
    name: B
    filters: 'status = done'

cases.expected:
filters:
  and:
    - 'file.hasProperty("status")'
formulas:
  total: '1 + 1'
views:
  - type: table
    name: A
    filters: 'file.name != x'
    order:
      - file.name
      - asc
  - type: table
    name: B
    filters: 'status = done'
